text: Fixed and checked: middleware/proxy.go now returns 503 (echo.ErrServiceUnavailable) when the balancer yields no target (nil), and randomBalancer.Next / roundRobinBalancer.Next return nil instead of panicking (rand.Intn(0) / integer divide by zero) when there are no targets. Verified with a temporary test (custom nil-returning balancer, NewRandomBalancer(nil), NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil) -> all 503, no panic); full suite green (go test ./... ok), gofmt/vet clean, temp test removed.

Working on router.go: two agents are hunting the deviation (property/fuzz probing of Find for non-routable paths, plus a code-vs-comments audit). I'll report the fix and its verification as soon as the reproducer is pinned down.

Working on context.go: Scheme() must ignore invalid forwarded header values (only http/https accepted, case-insensitive) and fall through to the next header, finally falling back to "http". An agent is implementing and verifying it now (including the two named subtests and the full existing suite).

Working on bind.go: DefaultBinder.bindData currently panics for map destinations (reflect: NumField of non-struct type). An agent is adding the supported map binding (map[string][]string, map[string]string, map[string]interface{}, numeric/bool/time maps, error for unsupported element types, nil-map initialisation) and verifying it.

Working on group.go: an agent is comparing the group middleware handling (Group.Use/Add/Group, Echo.Group/add, middleware slice handling) against the documented behaviour and the existing group tests to pin down the deviation behind TestMultipleGroupSamePathMiddleware, then fixing it.

Working on middleware/compress.go: with Accept-Encoding: gzip an empty body (e.g. c.String(200, "")) currently leaks the 10-byte gzip header into the response body while the Content-Encoding header is removed. An agent is making empty writes a no-op so empty responses stay pristine, and verifying the full suite.
